notes.title: Invasher 1.4 Story Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139881/e99a81099aa06f6dcb163d2cfba332f95bd65297.png[/img]

There aren't much of the update but to finish up the things like
story and some graphics, additional with some gameplay enhance features like
random enemies or you only have 1 HP and fix some bugs.

[h2]Update List[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]new artwork (probably final version)[/b]
[*] [b]improved story and event view[/b]
[*] improved some graphics
[*] [b]rearrange and upgrade quality of soundtrack[/b]
[*] change soundtrack DLC to actually soundtrack category
[*] change some of sound effects
[*] make normal difficulty easier
[*] [b]add 2 items - increase invincible time after get attacked and player has no attack delay on boss[/b]
[*] add some of new enemies
[*] [b]player punch faster[/b]
[*] all playable character now have the same stats for balance VS mode
[*] [b]new Master Bear's Fortress[/b]
[*] move bossrush mode into Master Bear's Fortress
[*] move stage select entry to the right side of base map
[*] move new entry to stage 9-15 by get into the spaceship
[*] [b]steam screenshot is now working![/b]
[*] [b]give rewards and abilities to modify the gameplay when player collected all the golden eggs[/b]
[*] fixed bug leaderboards sign not working
[/list]

notes.title: v1.3 Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34139881/20120d99c001e2782e394c83efc4c5ff1e9a5aad.png[/img]

[h2]CO-OP Mode[/h2]
Play any stages and custom items on local up to 4 players

[h2]Versus Mode[/h2]
Fight each other with mixed or any stages and custom items on local up to 4 players

[h2]Story Mode[/h2][list]
[*] New Items, Show Damage, Show HP
[*] Improved some of story and character graphics (Final version of character design)
[*] Can switch character
[*] Bossrush give rewards on single run or full run (great money source)
[*] Single Bossrush move to outside
[*] Buffed light weapon
[/list]

[h2]Misc[/h2][list]
[*] Fixed bug on stage 11 when you can fall out of map
[/list]

[h2]Future Update[/h2][list]
[*] Post game on story mode
[*] Expand more story
[*] More variety of versus mode
[*] Rebalance more stages
[*] Improve all animations
[/list]

Also change website name from [url=https://www.jomjakgames.com]www.jomjakgames.com[/url] to -> [url=https://www.jomjak.com/games]www.jomjak.com/games[/url]

[h2]Quick fix[/h2]
[h3]v1.3.0.1[/h3][list]
[*] Fixed keyboard not working if no controller connected
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.2 Revamp! new weapons, items, upgrades and more!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34139881/7a33e8ebdc7dfc1333bb87253ad0e082dd24d607.png[/img]

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] New 8 Weapons
[*] New Element System
[*] New EP (Energy Point)
[*] New GP Currency
[*] Save data now have 9 slots
[*] 3 Difficulty, Easy, Normal, Hard
[*] New Base system act like lobby
[*] New Sound room, you can play any soundtrack at the base
[*] Added 6 more stages to main game, now total 15 stages
[*] Stage 1-8 can now be played at any order
[*] Rebalanced all stages
[*] Added some new platformer each stage
[*] Added more variety of enemies
[*] Added little some of story scenes
[*] Added helping block on easy difficulty
[*] Added new items and upgrades to help progress the game
[*] HP and EP can be upgrade from 5 to 10
[*] Enemies now have change to drop HP, EP or player life
[*] Player can now run, which buy item in a shop
[*] Freeplay and Bossrush now a part of main game
[*] Added directional, danger and other sign
[*] Decreased hitbox on boss bullets
[/list]

[h1]Graphics[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved all assets, model, color etc
[*] New actual button GUI for Xbox One and PS4
[*] Changed logo and character image	
[/list]

[h1]Sounds[/h1]
[list]
[*] More new soundtrack and remastered all tracks
[*] OG Version now call as plus version
[*] Added some new sound effects
[/list]

[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
[*] Compressed all bgm files, the result is decreased file game size by a lot!
[*] Hide mouse cursor when not move after 3 seconds
[*] Change Save/Load file system to support new update
[*] Player will not died by fall to a pit or lava after defeated a boss
[*] Added new achievements and change some to match the new update
[*] New leaderboards, old score will keep it for a while and will be deleted later cause by gameplay has a major change
[*] Fixed cancel bossrush score submission by press back button cause story data to reset
[*] Fixed wall collision not matched on tiles on some map
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34139881/d913c43393da826ba7369d5897e4542b1ea8d092.png[/img]
Some of new base system act like lobby

Hope this update will make gameplay really better and easier to play.
If you found any bugs feel free to give a comment here.
Have fun!

notes.title: Update v1.0.1 added cheat codes!? and some minor changes
notes.content:
Cheat codes
1. Go to main menu and press F1
2. Type "[b]GIVEME30LIFES[/b]" and press enter
3. It will say "cheat GIVEME30LIFES on!!" and will hear a life up sound

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34139881/ea9a7f2559234c4b1941ae94d9676b7daf383625.png[/img]

This will give you 30 lifes when start new game.
I highly recommended use this when you play for first time.
It's really help you learning boss patterns without doing a whole stage again.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34139881/39b55d650ae22a7581956fdc2e7d9a819a56f6bd.png[/img]

And some minor changes.

have fun! (°∀°)b
